question: Two equal circles of radius 18 cm intersect each other, such that each passes through the centre of the other. The length of the common chord is _________.
solution:
Given:

The radius of the circles is 18 cm

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3afc63f0eca2ecfe9868260514654abc4150ccd6858431e86499eef1bb176331.png] 

According to the diagram,

AD = DB

O₁O₂ = 18

Again O₁A = O₂A = 18 [Radius of the circle]

∠ADO₁ = 90°

O₁D = O₂D = 9

AD = √(324 - 81)

⇒ (9√3) 

AB = 2 × (9√3) = 18√3 = 6√27

∴ The length of the common chord is 6√27 cm.
